target.role: Fresh whole-journey discovery after Run 150 correctly rejected three placement-specific redundancies and left no actionable repair
target.position: Whole 42-track journey; preserve Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer. Contrast may pass only when transition, local-run and long-form consequences are deliberate.
target.purpose: Explore Kelela's current rhythm-and-noise reconfigurations and Pole's overlooked rhythm-versus-decay catalogue without recycling the recent RRUCCULLA, 96 Back, Gold Panda, Boards of Canada or Theo Parrish windows.

explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 54 named tracks, releases and catalogue references across live September 2026 review feeds, Kelela's July 2026 new avatar, Pole's 2022 Tempus and 2007 Steingarten catalogues, plus adjacent current Bandcamp windows; attributed criticism and release metadata only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Run 150 Boards of Canada, Theo Parrish and BEAM WONG decisions and alternates were not recycled.
Recent Run 139–150 Carmen Villain, DJ Phil, DJ POPS, Four Tet, Plaid, JWords, foodman, RRUCCULLA, 96 Back, Gold Panda and Boards of Canada fields were excluded by repository freshness checks.
Bitchin Bajas — Ajami and current August Bandcamp candidates already present in persistent history were excluded; no PARKED item was resurfaced without materially new evidence.
Tracks supported only by generic genre framing, prestige, or titles were inspected but did not clear the lead floor.
No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
rankedLeadSummary: 5. Kelela, A. K. Paul — outta time
sourceWindows: CURRENT WINDOW: Kelela's July 2026 new avatar supplied exact-track descriptions of crashing funky breaks, controlled noise bursts, sparse handclaps and circular echo endings. https://ra.co/reviews/36360

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE WINDOW: Pole's 2022 Tempus supplied exact descriptions of decaying percussion, dub-tail momentum, malfunctioning-synth disruption and piano-versus-drone structure. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/pole-tempus/

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE WINDOW: Pole's 2007 Steingarten supplied exact descriptions of delayed elements slipping out of time and opposing textures finding unexpected convergence. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/10000-steingarten/
FRESHNESS CHECK: repository searches found no durable prior record for Kelela or these requested Pole tracks; recent selected, unresolved and parked fields were excluded.
